summary: Three static blockers: incomplete parametrized reports can produce PASS, required invalid-data tests are omitted, and command/commit provenance is missing. Checks were not run because this review is read-only.

checks.criterion: AC1: Failing-first gate tests, fixed fixture IDs, and listed invalid-data tests
checks.evidence: fixtures/polarimetry/g1_required_tests.json:79 omits existing invalid-input tests, including test_polarimetry_decode.py:338, test_polarimetry_stokes.py:511, and test_polarimetry_covariance.py:831. Failing-first execution could not be verified; checks were prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC2: CLI records actual JUnit results and never passes incomplete required evidence
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:3043 matches any parametrized case of a required function; :3057 marks it passed without checking expected case completeness. :3097 can consequently return PASS with required cases absent.

checks.criterion: AC3: Tested status rules and accurate real-scene scope
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_gate.py:348-490 contains meaningful status and real-scene scope assertions. Execution was prohibited because the sandbox is read-only.

checks.criterion: AC4: Generated output at the requested path with exact command and commit notes
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:3190-3218 builds the complete record without notes or a commit identifier. :3253 reconstructs the recorder invocation, rather than recording the evidence-producing pytest command. fixtures/polarimetry/g1-record.json:7 has the same omissions.

checks.criterion: AC5: Real failing-run and tampered-report tests, T0 validation, and preserved nulls
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_gate.py:562 checks T0 validation and nulls; :890 asserts a deliberately failing pytest run and recorder both exit nonzero; :917 removes required tests from a real report. These tests were read but execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Changed paths remain within story ownership
checks.evidence: Only g1-record.json, g1_required_tests.json, polarimetry.py, and test_polarimetry_gate.py changed. No config/run.yaml or outputs changes.

findings.claim: Missing parametrized cases can produce a false G1 PASS.
findings.evidence: A function passes whenever its remaining matching cases passed; no expected case inventory is checked. For example, deleting test_F7_matches_both_oracles[0.1] while retaining [0.9] still marks that required function passed. Both cases are declared in test_polarimetry_covariance.py:233. With all other IDs passed, :3097 returns PASS. Require complete case IDs and test removal of a single parametrized case.

findings.claim: The required-test manifest omits invalid-data tests from stories 1–3, violating AC1.
findings.evidence: Omitted examples are test_decode_rejects_a_non_integer_nodata (test_polarimetry_decode.py:338), test_s2_and_s3_are_given_together_or_not_at_all and test_product_mask_must_be_boolean (test_polarimetry_stokes.py:511 and :555), and test_product_mask_broadcasts_and_must_be_boolean (test_polarimetry_covariance.py:831). Their absence does not prevent PASS; the subprocess at test_polarimetry_gate.py:826 selects only listed IDs.

findings.claim: Generated records lack the required command/commit provenance notes.
findings.evidence: The result and GateRecord constructors contain no notes or commit SHA. main at :3253 records only a reconstructed record-g1 invocation, with no evidence-producing pytest invocation. The committed g1-record.json likewise contains neither notes nor a commit, so its results cannot be tied to the tested revision as AC4 requires.
